## 7:00 IST — Last day

Through Day 16 the desk has Ramayana at ₹895.3 Cr India nett, ₹1,051.0 Cr India gross, ₹523.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,574.0 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹879.50 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹18.10 Cr and ENE Repeat at ₹3.10 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The Week is citing about ₹650.0 Cr, NDTV is citing about ₹1,500.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹895.3 Cr India nett and ₹1,574.0 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
